title: WeedNet published in Nature Communications
body: A foundation model for global-to-local weed species identification, trained on 14 million images spanning 1,593 species.

title: CVPR 2026: panel and workshop talk
body: Prof. Sarkar joined a panel with Gary Bradski, Jason Corso, Girish Chowdhary and Shenlong Wang and presented agentic visual reasoning for agriculture at the Vision for Agriculture workshop; Tirtho Roy presented SAGE at the DataMFM workshop.

title: Dr. Homagni Saha joins IIT Kharagpur
body: Lab alumnus Dr. Homagni Saha joins the faculty of IIT Kharagpur.

title: AgGym released
body: A modular, open-source Gym environment that simulates biotic stress spread and yield loss to evaluate crop-management strategies, including reinforcement learning.

title: DARPA Ag × BTO selection
body: An Iowa State team led by Prof. Sarkar was selected under the DARPA Ag × BTO program to build an early-warning system for biological threats to U.S. agriculture.

title: Two new Ph.D.s
body: Dr. Ashutosh Nirala and Dr. Ibne Farabi Shihab were hooded at the December 2025 commencement.

title: ICCPS 2025 paper presented
body: Joshua Waite presented work using a reinforcement-learning agent to generate synthetic data that improves the spatial reasoning of vision-language models.

title: Prof. Sarkar receives the PECASE
body: Soumik Sarkar received the Presidential Early Career Award for Scientists and Engineers, nominated by NSF.

title: MLCAS 2024
body: The Sixth International Workshop on Machine Learning for Cyber-Agricultural Systems drew 150+ attendees, six invited speakers and 30+ contributed talks and posters.
